# Verify Compilation State

The verify function performs a shadow compile to determine if the current state of the repository is equivalent to a fresh full compile. It checks for any divergences and provides a report indicating the state of the repository.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.verify`
